projects.title: Portfolio & Resume Website
projects.subtitle: Data-driven static portfolio and résumé site
projects.shortDescription: A content-driven portfolio built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. All copy and structure are defined in JSON; a single script detects the URL, loads the right data, and renders the page—no build step.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Designed and built a clean, minimal portfolio website to present my resume, professional experience, and technical projects. The site is fully data-driven: content lives in JSON files under data/, and a shared content script (content.js) determines the page type from the URL, fetches the appropriate JSON, and injects the rendered HTML into a single root element. Adding or editing projects, experience, skills, or service entries requires only JSON and an HTML shell file per detail page—no build or CMS.

sections.title: Site Structure
paragraphs: Static HTML shells (index, experience/index, projects/index, skills, education, service/index, contact) each contain a nav, a main content root, and a footer. The script infers page type (home, list, or detail) from the path and filename. Home shows a hero (name, intro, profile image), a tech stack logo grid from techstack.json, and a Featured Experience section (one experience plus up to two projects, configured in site.json). List pages render cards from the corresponding JSON; detail pages (e.g. projects/slug.html, experience/slug.html, service/slug.html) resolve the slug from the URL, find the matching entry in JSON, and render the full detail view. All links, resume path, and featured IDs are controlled via site.json and the data README documents which file controls what.

sections.title: Key Features
list: Fully data-driven: site.json, projects.json, experience.json, skills.json, techstack.json, education.json, service.json, and contact.json control all content; no content in HTML.
Single content renderer (content.js) handles home, list, and detail pages via URL-based routing and fetch of JSON.
Detail pages use one static HTML file per slug (e.g. projects/ella-rises.html); the script loads projects.json and renders the project with that slug—no build step.
Home includes a configurable tech stack grid and clickable Featured Experience cards that link to the corresponding experience or project detail pages.
Deployed as a static site on GitHub Pages with a GitHub Actions workflow and optional custom domain (CNAME).
Modular CSS (main.css, responsive.css), shared nav and footer injected from site data, and responsive layout with reveal animations.

sections.title: Technologies Used
paragraphs: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, JSON, GitHub Pages, GitHub Actions
